# Ruslan Barysiuk — IT Project Manager / Technical PM

IT / Technical Project Manager: 5 years running mobile and web projects plus 8+ years in business management and sales. Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Jira, schedule, risk and stakeholder management, App Store and Google Play releases. Remote.

IT project manager with 13+ years in management: 8+ years leading sales, teams and my own businesses across industries (e-commerce, offline retail business, B2C/B2B sales), and the last 5 years running mobile and web projects — from requirements to App Store and Google Play release. 6 products shipped.

Hands-on technical background (I'm a developer myself): honest estimates, risks surfaced early, no hand-waving from the team. On every project I analyzed and set up the PM process: backlog, sprints, roadmap, status reporting, acceptance, code delivery. I use AI tools (Claude, Cursor) daily to produce specs, documentation and reports several times faster.

## Key skills

- **Project management:** Project management, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Project planning, Work breakdown structure (WBS), Estimation, Roadmapping, Risk management, Change management, Scope management, Budget tracking, Status reporting, Acceptance, Release management
- **People & business:** Team leadership, Stakeholder management, Cross-functional teams, Negotiation, Business communication, B2B / B2C sales, Client management, Task assignment
- **Requirements & analytics:** Requirements gathering, Technical specifications, User stories, API contracts, Customer development, Product analytics (Firebase, Adjust)
- **Tools:** Jira, Confluence, Linear, Trello, Notion, Miro, Figma, Hubstaff, Google Sheets, GitHub / GitLab, Postman, Claude, Cursor
- **Technical context:** iOS / Android, Flutter, REST API, CI/CD, TestFlight, App Store / Google Play review, In-app purchases & subscriptions

Менеджер IT-проектов: 5 лет управления мобильными и веб-проектами и 8+ лет менеджмента и продаж до IT. Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Jira, управление сроками, рисками и стейкхолдерами, релизы в App Store и Google Play. Удалённо.

Менеджер IT-проектов с 13+ годами в управлении: 8+ лет руководил продажами, командами и собственным бизнесом в разных сферах (e-commerce, офлайн-бизнес, B2C/B2B-продажи), последние 5 лет веду мобильные и веб-проекты — от сбора требований до релиза в App Store и Google Play. 6 продуктов в сторах.

Технический бэкграунд (сам разработчик) — оценки честные, риски видны заранее, разработчики не «напускают тумана». На каждом проекте разбирал и выстраивал процессы PM: бэклог, спринты, роадмап, статусы, приёмка, поставка кода по регламенту. Каждый день работаю с AI-инструментами (Claude, Cursor) — ТЗ, документация и отчёты в разы быстрее.
